model.name: Qwen Image 2.1 BF16 7B
model.description: Full BF16 DiT (14.2 GB) plus BF16 Qwen3-VL-8B (17.5 GB) and the 2.1 RGBA VAE. Highest fidelity, native 2K. On a 4090 the encoder must offload; peak BF16 resident is ~30 GB. Prefer INT8 ConvRot unless you are comparing quality. License: Qwen Research License.
model.selector_help: Quality reference, not the 4090 daily driver. BF16 T2I on 4090 needs encoder offload (SGLang ~22.7 GiB with offload; fully resident BF16 does not fit 24 GB). Use this to A/B against INT8. First download about 33 GB.

resource_requirements.note: 4090 can run it with encoder offload. 48 GB GPUs keep the full stack resident.
